All sampled transactions show 0 errors and low p50/p95 (p95 ≤ 168 ms), with maximum latencies near 1 s on several transactions (checkout max 1,092 ms vs p99 142 ms; home max 1,009 ms vs p99 197 ms). hypotheses.observation: Checkout has max latency 1092 ms while p99 is 142 ms; home has max 1009 ms with p99 197 ms; add product to cart has max 974 ms with p99 88 ms; reset cart has max 993 ms with p99 85 ms. Resource series (checkoutservice, frontend) show low, fairly flat CPU means (0.047 and 0.180 cores).
hypotheses.possible_explanation: Infrequent slow samples create outliers far above p99 while typical latency stays low; this could reflect transient contention, garbage collection, or cold-start behavior, but the evidence provides no timestamp correlation or causal link for these maxima.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Extract the timestamps of the samples near each transaction's max latency and overlay checkoutservice/frontend cpu_cores and memory_bytes 15-second interval means to test whether outliers coincide with resource changes.

hypotheses.observation: All three monitored services show positive memory slopes over 23 observed cells at 15-second intervals: paymentservice memory mean 33,023,347 bytes with slope_per_second 4658.28 and split_half_shift 610,304; frontend mean 12,059,871 bytes with slope_per_second 2239.44; checkoutservice mean 9,282,456 bytes with slope_per_second 1883.45.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: A consistently positive slope could indicate growing memory usage, but a ~5.75-minute window is too short to establish a leak, and slope_per_second is a summary statistic rather than proof of a trend cause.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Extend monitoring over hours, compare first-half vs second-half memory means, and check container memory limits and restart behavior before concluding there is a leak.

hypotheses.recommended_check: Re-run the errors/errors query against opensearch and compare error counts for the full run window (1790619844691 to 1790620204660) to confirm the zero-error result covers samples outside the policy-check window.
